maddeler.e:
نستوقح (form X)
# نَسْتَوْقِحُ (nastawqiḥu) /nas.taw.qi.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْقَحَ (istawqaḥa)
# نَسْتَوْقِحَ (nastawqiḥa) /nas.taw.qi.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْقَحَ (istawqaḥa)
# نَسْتَوْقِحْ (nastawqiḥ) /nas.taw.qiħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَوْقَحَ (istawqaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
